t: You're looking at the Charles Dibdin Memorial Cross, a Celtic cross in Camden. It commemorates Charles Dibdin, who lived from 1745 to 1814. He was an English composer, musician, dramatist, novelist, singer and actor, and in his time the most prolific English singer-songwriter, with over 600 songs to his name. He is best known for the sea song Tom Bowling, which often features at the Last Night of the Proms. He also wrote about 30 dramatic pieces, including the operas The Waterman and The Quaker.
